capabilities: : Render PDF embeds as thumbnail grids
: Display PDFs in an in-note lightbox
: Configure grid layout and rendering settings
extras: The pdf.js decode worker is loaded from jsDelivr (a public CDN) on first use, requiring network access for the initial render.
intentEvidence: Render ![[file.pdf]] embeds in Obsidian as a lazy page-thumbnail grid with an in-note lightbox.
problem: Viewing large PDF files embedded in notes can be cumbersome, requiring external viewers or complex navigation.
summary: Renders PDF embeds in Obsidian as a lazy page-thumbnail grid with an in-note lightbox, allowing users to view PDF pages without leaving the note.
